ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels occupy approximately 90% of the interior surface area, contrasted by a low-intensity black/dark-gray peripheral border occupying approximately 10%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity band following the entire trailing edge and distal tips. The interior is a uniform light-intensity field with sparse, low-contrast grayish mottling in the center-right region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex angle and a depth of approximately 45 pixels relative to the peak of the adjacent lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire margin; right distal tip exhibits higher amplitude, jagged peaks (approx. 5-8 pixels) compared to the smoother, lower-amplitude wave pattern on the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in a sharp downward hook at the lateral extremities.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical dark border framing the light-colored ventral surface, with distinct pixel-level 'stepping' on the right lobe tip's serrations.
